verdict: Leads surged and cost per lead is excellent — but visibility gaps remain.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 30 leads from Meta at a cost per lead of $6.15, and the most recent week saw leads jump 229% over the week prior — a strong efficiency signal. That momentum is real, but it is currently running blind: your website recorded 3,370 sessions this period and zero tracked conversions, meaning booked appointments are not visible in reporting. Conversion tracking is being repaired so that gap closes. Separately, nine project milestones — covering search campaigns, landing pages, nurture sequences, and local search verification — remain outstanding, and resolving those is the active priority heading into the final stretch of Phase 1 this month.

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile actions dropped 32% week-over-week and went quiet for three consecutive days (Sep 14–16), while paid leads held steady — offline intent is drifting from paid momentum.
watch_item.fix: We are monitoring GBP activity daily and cross-referencing with paid lead volume to catch any further divergence before it affects appointment flow.
